'''Nocto''' was a world located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from Nocto attacked [[Ochotl]]'s orbital depots.<ref name="EGtW:AC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Telgorn shipyard|shipyard]] [[Calenz]] was located in space near Nocto. The shipyard was [[Battle of Nocto|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]''</ref>
